CalorAI

Who they are

CalorAI is a personal AI calorie tracker + nutrition coach for body transformation. You talk to 'Kai', your AI coach, via iMessage / WhatsApp / the app — send a food photo, voice note, or text to track calories & macros in seconds, get tailored nutrition guidance, and use 3D body scans to see progress beyond the scale. Developer: Freehold Ventures. iOS + Android.

What they want

  • (Angle inferred from the product + the CalorAI Creator Campaign brief — $25/video + $1/1k views, create & manage a new account for UGC; swap in a fuller brief anytime.)
  • Angle to model: calorie-tracking / body-transformation content that bridges into CalorAI — 'what I eat in a day', snap-a-photo-to-track-macros, 'I stopped guessing my calories', high-protein meals, before/after transformations, 'my AI coach keeps me on track'.
  • Why it converts: CalorAI removes the friction of manual logging — lead with the pain of tedious tracking / not seeing results, then show snapping a photo or texting Kai and the macros just appearing.
  • Study below: the competitor cards + keyword sections show the calorie-tracking / transformation formats that go viral, so you can replicate the winners.
